name: Fairness Suite
description: Tests whether a model can identify when policy benefits and burdens are distributed in an unjustifiably uneven way.

tasks.billText: A bill creates a large state tax credit for households with mortgage interest payments, but provides no equivalent housing support for renters or low-income households without mortgages.
A bill funds a new downtown business district by imposing a flat emergency surcharge on all utility bills, including households already enrolled in income-qualified assistance programs.

A bill expands childcare assistance using income-based eligibility, includes support for shift workers, and applies the same benefit rules to renters, homeowners, and informal caregivers meeting the statutory criteria.
